hints.title: Sort Jobs Descending
hints.text: Assigning the largest jobs first allows early pruning when accumulated load exceeds the current best maximum.

hints.title: Worker Symmetry Breaking
hints.text: If a worker currently has zero assigned time, assign the job to that worker and skip subsequent empty workers.

hints.title: Prune Suboptimal Branches
hints.text: If assigning a job to a worker meets or exceeds the current minimum upper bound, prune the branch immediately.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Assigning n jobs to k workers naively explores k^n states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Descending sort plus empty-worker symmetry reduction prunes vast portions of the state tree.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate explains symmetry-breaking optimizations and branch-and-bound pruning.
